_comment: Per-role MCP surface budgets over the canonical builtin and discovery definitions (ORB-21263). role_surface_budget fails when a role's tools or approximate tokens exceed its budget. Raising a budget is a reviewed decision: say in the PR why the role needs the extra surface. The resident role needs orbit.resident.metrics to inspect read-only mandate history; operator and manager include the resident toolset. `orbit tool list --role <role>` reports the current size.
